title: Assignment split by constraint scope
statement: Let $V$ be a finite set, let $r$ be a natural number, and let $C$ be a constraint from the maximum linear template of parameter $r$ on $V$. There is an equivalence between assignments $V \to \mathbb{F}_2$ and pairs consisting of an assignment of values in $\mathbb{F}_2$ to the ordered variables in the scope of $C$, and an assignment of values in $\mathbb{F}_2$ to the variables of $V$ outside that scope.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is a constraint from the maximum linear template of parameter $r$ on $V$
